notes: Third case of contagion note Sec.5.3, between the single seed (lacunary) and the interval [1, N0] (uniform). Ingredients are existing machinery: Paper A's rotation layer read mod 1 (J-lachesis-walk-rotation) and the flight-note height law plus transport bound (J-lachesis-loglog-clock). Excludes no fate; moves no period bound. The operational consequence, a deep natural-density census, is refuted as dominated (J-lachesis-census-dominated). Open: whether the same rotation also fixes which blocks carry Corollary 4.3's amplified density, or only the 1/n cycle-state floor. Extended to Clotho (J-clotho-basin-every-block-criterion): the same rotation gives a divergent orbit's basin the every-block statement at scale y iff the orbit has laid down O*(y) odd steps before its walk reaches log2(ln y / ln n) - an odd share within about 0.004 of q* up to 1e100, the critical-share regime; fast escapers have lacunary basins. The lower bound for a cycle is (K / ln y) sum_C 1/x with sum_C 1/x >= theta(L) ln n by Lean finance (J-lachesis-basin-inverse-sum); the upper bound on the full basin is the free term (J-lachesis-upper-bound-free-term). Scale threshold added later: bursts begin at n^2 and full coverage needs c(y) - c(n) >= 1 + u_max; the Clotho gate is vacuous for y < n^3 (Lean: the hug band is the minimal invariant band).
statement: If a nontrivial Juggler cycle of minimum n exists, its basin has natural density at least c/n on every dyadic block with y >= n^(2^(1 + u_max)), u_max the cycle's walk height, not merely on infinitely many: the cycle states' log-log clock positions c(x) = log2 log x are an equidistributed orbit of the rotation by log2(3/2), with largest gap 5.1e-6 at period 780239, and each state contributes an E-tree burst of density about 1/m at every scale m^(2^k). The same holds for the basin of a divergent orbit at every scale y at which the orbit has made at least O*(y) odd steps before its walk exceeds log2(ln y / ln n), with the partial inverse sum of the states below y in place of the cycle's inverse sum.
tested_range: clock defect on 200 odd starts per scale at 1e12..1e100 above N0 = 3.5e8; rotation gaps for periods 478245, 780239, 1082233; E-tree density exact for m in {11, 101}, generations 1-2
title: Cycle and slow-escape basins are not lacunary
